 Momentum fell harder than Bitcoin price, and one group of buyers may explain why
 The last time holder buying faded like this, Bitcoin did something unexpected
 One price level, about 7% away, decides whether the signal plays out

Promo [...] Hodler Net Position Change, a Glassnode metric that tracks the monthly change in coins held by long-term holders, peaked at 25,734 BTC on September 20. By October 8, it had dropped 96% to 1,051 BTC, its weakest positive reading in three months.

Holders are still adding, but barely. With selling below its October 2 peak and buyers thinning, price can hold a higher low while momentum drains.

#Bitcoin (BTC) Analysis

Bitcoin (BTC) price trades near $82,300, still up about 28% over three months after this week’s drop.

A hidden momentum signal on the daily chart suggests the uptrend can survive. The catch is that buying from long-term holders has dropped 96%.

## A Hidden Signal Says the Uptrend Is Still Alive

The MACD line sits at 689.960919, well below the signal line at 1170.124492, creating a negative histogram of -480.163572. This bearish crossover indicates momentum is already fading and sellers may be gaining control. Bitcoin price shows a divergence between the rising structure in price action and the falling momentum in MACD, a classic red flag that often precedes pullbacks or consolidations. Momentum buyers are stepping aside, and without fresh buying pressure, the upside is capped. [...] I am taking a neutral stance on Bitcoin because the cumulative score of 5.6 out of 10 does not give me sufficient conviction to lean long or short. The moving averages tell me the macro trend is still up, and Fibonacci confirms price is in a structurally sound zone, but the MACD rollover, falling OBV, and double top pattern are all telling me momentum is fading into resistance. My strategy is to wait for either a bullish confirmation break above $87,200.73 on strong volume or a breakdown below [...] ## Overview

Bitcoin is trading at $83,770.4 on October 13, 2026, positioned between a rising trendline at $86,048.15 and its immediate support at $82,722.65. The Bitcoin BTC price remains well above the 200-day EMA of $72,169.26, suggesting the macro uptrend is intact, yet the current candle sits in a zone of indecision with price hovering just below the Bollinger Bands upper band at $86,368.71. This is not a market screaming conviction in either direction.

The bullish trendline is losing momentum in the short term:Over recent months, Bitcoin has maintained a consistent sequence of higher highs and higher lows, allowing the development of a relevant bullish trendline on the daily chart. However, the recent lack of direction is beginning to reflect a more evident loss of buying momentum.
